title: 第十四章 是你找死
content_zh:
“嗯，怎么没接电话？现在十二点多，应该是吃饭时间。我爸他们装修，中午一般都是休息的，该接电话才对啊。”罗峰疑惑在手机屏幕上点了一下‘手机定位查找功能’，手机屏幕上很快就显示出了扬州城的地图，其中一个红色小点是罗峰自己所在的位置。而绿色小点，就是父亲手机所在位置。
“离我这不太远。”
罗峰一下子就清楚父亲现在的位置，不由露出一丝笑容，“我跑到爸身边，亲自告诉他我成为准武者的消息。”
当即，罗峰按照手机中地图显示，迅速赶去。
××××××
宜安区，天都花园小区。
“快点，你们东西都搬快点，你们好去休息吃午饭。我们也好去吃饭啊。”小区内的其中一栋联排别墅的私人庭院中，一身白色体恤、白色长裤的张昊白皱眉催促道，在他的身侧还站着三名面容冷峻的保镖。
“先生，别急，这家具可是贵重物品，不能大意啊，哥几个，加把力！”只见私人庭院外的小区路道上停着一辆卡车，卡车上则是包封完好的木制家具。
木制家具，在如今这个年代是非常昂贵的，属于少数人的奢侈品！
因为，人类都是居住在基地市区内，栽种树木的地方极为稀少，大多是为了美化作用。而是人类基地市区外，的确是有大量生长的树木，可是人类基地市区外也同样有着怪兽，为了砍伐运输树木而去和怪兽厮杀，可想而知这成本有多高！
现如今大多数人家的家具，都是塑料制品，高点的就是玻璃制品。
木制品，非一般人家买得起的。
“小心点。”
这装饰公司的员工们小心翼翼的将沉重的家具，先从车上搬到地面上。而后三名员工一起小心翼翼的搬着家具进入了私人庭院。
“你们小心点。”张昊白皱眉提醒道，“这可是实木家具，都是上等的木材。弄坏了，你们老板肯定要找你们麻烦。”
“呼，呼。”
三名员工小心翼翼的搬着，这家具用材很好，重量也非常重，有一千多斤，这三名员工搬起来有些吃力。
“哥几个，先停下歇息一下。等会儿一口气搬进屋里。”在前面抬的员工开口道，“先将家具放在这地方，慢点，轻点放。”三名员工小心翼翼将家具放在庭院地面上，这才直起腰，长舒一口气。
“老罗，我这肚子都饿了。”一名体型高大的装修公司员工活动了一下身体。
“搬完这套，还有两套家具。全部搬完了，大家一起去吃饭。”罗洪国笑呵呵的看着另外两名工友，他也随意的用衣服擦了一下满头汗，现在可是七月，又是快中午一点，正是一天最热的时候。

三个人搬一千多斤的贵重家具，的确是苦力活。
“你们快点！”张昊白有些不耐烦的催促道。
“好嘞。”罗洪国弯下腰抓住家具，“哥几个，加把力，把这套家具送进去。”
“来，一，二，三，起！”
罗洪国他们三人一起用力，抬起家具，而后小心翼翼沿着台阶一步步上，很快就进入了屋子，片刻后就走了出来。当罗洪国他们三名工友走过张昊白几人旁边的时候，那一身汗味直接弥漫开，张昊白不由皱起眉头。
“穷人就是穷人，做这种苦力活，一辈子都是做苦力的命。”张昊白心中暗道。
他爸是富豪，出身于富裕家庭，张昊白天生对于那些社会的最底层，做苦力活的人有一种歧视。在他看来，这些甘愿做苦力活的人没有拼搏奋斗精神，活该过这种苦日子。
“小心点，别碰到大门。”
罗洪国三人小心翼翼的一步步抬着家具前进，他们的衣服完全被汗湿了，汗珠从额头上渗出，而后滑落滚进脖子里。
“在屋外歇息下。”罗洪国三人将家具再度放下，略微歇息调整一下呼吸。
“走，一，二，三，起！”
罗洪国三人虽然累，可是这种伙他们做了二三十年，也习惯了。知道自己的承受力极限在哪，所以搬运东西很少出错。
片刻后，罗洪国他们又去搬运最后一套家具。
“天真热。”张昊白仰头看看天，“王哥，等会儿，我们去旁边的酒楼撮一顿。”
“谢谢少爷啦。”这三名保镖都笑呵呵应道。
张昊白瞥了一眼正在搬最后一套家具的三名装修工，鼻子中不由发出一声低哼。对这种泥腿子，张昊白自然而然讨厌的很，忽然张昊白目光落在了庭院中用来铺道的大理石，其中一块大理石正有着裂痕，这道裂痕是前几天他和保镖切磋时，不小心弄坏的。
“嗯？”张昊白眼睛一亮，“最近零花钱不多，刚好能弄点来！”
这时候，罗洪国三人正搬运着第三套家具。
忽然――
一阵手机彩铃声响起，正在搬运家具的罗洪国心中一喜：“应该是小峰的电话。”不过罗洪国正在搬家具，根本没办法接电话，所以只能忍着准备等放下家具时候再会打过去。

“在屋外先歇息下，轻放，慢点。”罗洪国三人轻轻将家具放下。
罗洪国掏出口袋里的手机，一看来电显示，正是儿子打来的，不由一笑准备回拨过去。
“你们怎么回事？”
“啊，让你们小心点，你们几个怎么搞的？”一道怒斥声猛地响起。
罗洪国等三名装饰公司员工都是一愣，转头看去。只见张昊白脸色阴沉，手指怒指着家具压着的大理石路面：“你们怎么做事的？不认真点，看，我家的路面都被你们压坏了。这可是南山大理石，是专门去基地市区外才能弄到的。一块大理石要十几万块的，你们赔得起吗？啊！！！”
罗洪国三人低头一看――
果真，家具下面的路面上，其中一块大理石的确裂开了一道小裂痕。
“哼，我问问你们公司老板，怎么回事。”张昊白怒气冲冲，“王哥，你有他们装修公司电话的吧，打电话，给他们装修公司。让他们老板过来！跟这几个人说再多也没用。”
“我这有他们装修公司的电话。”那姓王的保镖立即取出手机，开始拨打。
罗洪国三人彼此相识。
“不对。”体型高大的装饰公司员工，立即说道，“这大理石上的裂痕，之前就有了。我看到过。”
“还狡辩，狡辩有个屁用。”张昊白嗤笑一声。
罗洪国眉头一皱，作为一个经验丰富的老员工，他知道这种扯皮的事情最麻烦。而且公司一般都很注重声誉，一旦真的被敲诈，而公司有没有证据证明这大理石裂痕，不是他们员工弄裂开的，结果一般是公司只能赔钱。
公司赔钱，那么负责搬运的三名员工肯定是要被扣工资的。
“哥几个，先把家具搬进去再说。”罗洪国开口道，说着就要去抬家具。
“搬进去？”
张昊白上前两步，一把推搡开罗洪国，环视一眼三名员工喝道，“别耍花样！这家具压在大理石上，这就是证据！你们想把家具搬进屋，然后来个死不承认？哼，你们这种小手段我见多了。等你们老板来了再说。”
“老罗，老罗。”
另外两名工友连去将被推倒跌倒在地的罗洪国扶起。
“没事。”罗洪国揉了揉肩膀。

“你们怎么推人啊。”
“这大理石是不是我们弄坏的还不清楚，你们推人干什么？”另外两名工友立即瞪眼怒喝道，这些做苦工的可是天不怕地不怕，真的惹火起来大不了打上一架。到时候就算被抓进警察局，他们这些人要钱没有要命一条，警察局一般也没办法，还是会放走这些人的。
“别跟我耍横！”张昊白闪电般就是两脚，踹在那二人肚子上。
噗！噗！
直接将两名工友踹得倒飞出去，跌倒在地。
“哼，耍横也不看看地方。”张昊白冷笑一声，他张家在宜安区也算是人脉挺广，打几个普通苦工一顿，又算的了什么。
“老田，大猴。没事吧。”罗洪国也是急了。
“你这个年轻人，怎么这样。”罗洪国怒喝道。
张昊白闻到罗洪国身上的汗味，不由眉头一皱，挥手道：“王哥，你们几个教训他们一顿，让他们安静点。”
“少爷，装饰公司那边的。”那姓王的保镖手机递过来。
“嗯。”张昊白挥挥手，那三名保镖立即去教训那三名工人，而张昊白拿着电话，“对，我是天都花园这边的，让你们老总姓侯的接电话，侯总，今天你们送货的人怎么回事啊？粗手粗脚的，把我家庭院的大理石路面都给弄裂开了。你们快点来人，看着办吧！这事情不解决，家具的尾款你们也别想要了！”
话音未落――
“住手！”一声暴喝从庭院外传来。
此刻罗洪国等三名工友，被那三名身高马大的保镖给逼得站在庭院角落中，身上满是脚印。
“嗯？”三名保镖、张昊白三人都转头看去。
只见一道模糊身影瞬间冲进庭院，张昊白一眼认出来了，不由怒喝道：“罗峰，你竟然跑到我家来，给我打！”
“狗日的！”罗峰一眼就看到庭院中全身汗湿，身上还满是脚印的父亲弓着腰捂着肚子站在角落，眼睛一下子就红了，父亲这么多年来坐着这种苦活，还要遭人白眼，今天竟然还遭受这种事情。
三名保镖其中一个略显矮胖的男子冷笑上前一步。
“给我死开！！！”罗峰暴喝一声，闪电般就是沉重的一脚，狠狠的踹过去。那矮胖保镖还用右臂格挡。
“蓬！”

沉重的一脚踹的那矮胖保镖立即瞪大眼睛，竟然悬空倒飞出去四五米，这才跌下。旁边另外两名保镖吓得一大跳。
“罗峰，你竟然到我家打我的人！”张昊白瞪着眼，暴喝道，“你找死。”
“是你找死！！！”罗峰双眸带着凶光，咬牙怒喝道。
――――――
兄弟们，番茄需要大家的推荐票！周推荐榜第一，只差一点点了。大家帮忙一把，推荐票都砸来吧！。

"Well, why didn't you answer the phone? It's past twelve o'clock, it should be dinner time. My dad and his team are decorating, and they usually have a break at noon, so it's time to answer the phone." Luo Feng was confused and clicked the 'mobile phone location search function' on the phone screen. A map of Yangzhou City was quickly displayed on the phone screen, and a small red dot was Luo Feng's own location. The green dot is the location of my father’s cell phone.
"It's not too far from me."
Luo Feng immediately understood his father's current position and couldn't help but smile. "I ran to dad and told him personally that I had become a quasi-warrior."
Immediately, Luo Feng rushed there according to the map display on his mobile phone.
××××××
Yi'an District, Tiandu Garden Community.
"Hurry up, move your things quickly, so you can go have a rest and have lunch. We can also go to eat." In the private courtyard of one of the townhouses in the community, Zhang Haobai, wearing a white T-shirt and white trousers, frowned and urged. There were three stern-faced bodyguards standing beside him.
"Sir, don't worry. This furniture is a valuable item. Don't be careless. Brothers, please work harder!" I saw a truck parked on the road outside the private courtyard, and the truck contained well-wrapped wooden furniture.
Wooden furniture is very expensive in this day and age and is a luxury item for a few people!
Because humans all live in the urban area of ​​the base, there are very few places where trees are planted, and most of them are for beautification. There are indeed a large number of trees growing outside the urban area of ​​the human base, but there are also monsters outside the urban area of ​​the human base. You can imagine how high the cost is to fight the monsters in order to cut down and transport trees!
Nowadays, most people's furniture is made of plastic products, and the higher ones are glass products.
Wooden products are not something ordinary people can afford.
"Be careful."
The employees of the decoration company carefully moved the heavy furniture from the car to the ground. Then the three employees carefully moved the furniture into the private courtyard together.
"Be careful." Zhang Haobai frowned and reminded, "This is solid wood furniture, and it is all high-quality wood. If it is damaged, your boss will definitely cause trouble for you."
"Hoo, hoo."
The three employees moved it carefully. The furniture was made of very good materials and weighed more than a thousand kilograms. It was a bit difficult for the three employees to move it.
"Brothers, please stop and have a rest. We will move it into the house in one go later." The employee who was carrying it in front said, "Put the furniture here first, slowly and gently." The three employees carefully placed the furniture on the ground in the courtyard, then straightened up and breathed a sigh of relief.
"Lao Luo, I'm so hungry." A tall decoration company employee moved his body.
"After moving this set, there are still two sets of furniture. After moving them all, let's go have dinner together." Luo Hongguo looked at the other two workers with a smile. He also casually wiped his sweaty brow with his clothes. It was July, and it was almost noon, which was the hottest time of the day.
It was indeed hard work for three people to move more than a thousand kilograms of valuable furniture.
"Hurry up!" Zhang Haobai urged impatiently.
"Okay." Luo Hongguo bent down and grabbed the furniture, "Brothers, please work harder and put this set of furniture in."
"Come on, one, two, three, get up!"
Luo Hongguo and the three of them worked together to lift the furniture, then carefully walked up the steps step by step, quickly entered the house, and walked out after a while. When Luo Hongguo and three other workers passed by Zhang Haobai and the others, the smell of sweat permeated the air, and Zhang Haobai couldn't help but frown.
"Poor people are poor people. If you do this kind of hard work, you will be a hard worker for the rest of your life." Zhang Haobai thought to himself.
His father is a rich man and he comes from a wealthy family. Zhang Haotian is naturally interested in those social aspects.At the lowest level, there is a kind of discrimination against people who do hard work. In his opinion, these people who are willing to do hard work have no fighting spirit and deserve to live such a hard life.
"Be careful not to touch the gate."
Luo Hongguo and the other three carefully carried the furniture step by step. Their clothes were completely soaked with sweat. Sweat beads seeped out from their foreheads, then rolled down their necks.
"Have a rest outside the house." Luo Hongguo and the others put down the furniture again and took a short rest to catch their breath.
"Let's go, one, two, three, get up!"
Although Luo Hongguo and the others were tired, they had been doing this for twenty or thirty years and were used to it. You know where your endurance limit is, so you rarely make mistakes when moving things.
After a while, Luo Hongguo and the others went to move the last set of furniture.
"It's so hot." Zhang Haobai looked up at the sky, "Brother Wang, let's go to the restaurant next door to have a meal."
"Thank you, Master." The three bodyguards responded with a smile.
Zhang Haobai glanced at the three decorators who were moving the last set of furniture, and couldn't help but let out a low snort. Zhang Haobai naturally disliked this kind of mud legs. Suddenly, Zhang Haobai's eyes fell on the marbles used to pave the courtyard. One of the marbles had a crack. This crack was accidentally broken when he was sparring with the bodyguards a few days ago.
"Huh?" Zhang Haopai's eyes lit up, "I don't have much pocket money recently, so I can just get some!"
At this time, Luo Hongguo and the others were carrying the third set of furniture.
suddenly——
A burst of ringtones rang on his mobile phone, and Luo Hongguo, who was moving furniture, felt happy: "It should be Xiaofeng's call." However, Luo Hongguo was moving furniture and couldn't answer the phone at all, so he could only endure and prepare to call again when he put down the furniture.
"Take a rest outside the house first, put it down gently and slowly." Luo Hongguo and the others gently put down the furniture.
Luo Hongguo took out his cell phone from his pocket and looked at the caller ID. It was his son who was calling. He couldn't help but smile and prepared to call back.
"What's wrong with you?"
"Ah, let you be careful. What did you guys do?" An angry voice suddenly sounded.
Luo Hongguo and other three decoration company employees were stunned and turned to look. Zhang Haobai's face was gloomy, and he pointed angrily at the marble pavement on which the furniture was pressed: "How do you do things? Don't be serious. Look, the pavement in my house has been crushed by you. This is Nanshan marble, which can only be obtained outside the city of the base. A piece of marble costs hundreds of thousands of yuan, can you afford to pay for it? Ah!!!"
Luo Hongguo and the others looked down -
Sure enough, a small crack did appear in one of the marbles on the pavement under the furniture.
"Hmph, let me ask the boss of your company what's going on." Zhang Haobai said angrily, "Brother Wang, do you have the phone number of their decoration company? Call them and ask their boss to come over! It's useless no matter how much you talk to these people."
"I have the phone number of their decoration company." The bodyguard surnamed Wang immediately took out his mobile phone and started making calls.
The three of Luo Hongguo knew each other.
"No." The tall decoration company employee said immediately, "The cracks on this marble have been there before. I have seen it before."
"You are still quibbling, but quibbling is of no use." Zhang Haobai sneered.
Luo Hongguo frowned. As an experienced employee, he knew that this kind of wrangling was the most troublesome. Moreover, companies generally attach great importance to reputation. Once they are really blackmailed, and does the company have evidence to prove that the marble cracks were not caused by their employees, the result is usually that the company can only lose money.
If the company loses money, then the three employees responsible for the transportation will definitely have their wages deducted.
"Brothers, let's move the furniture in first." Luo Hongguo said, going to carry the furniture.
"Moving in?"
Zhang Haobai took two steps forward, pushed Luo Hongguo away, looked around at the three employees and shouted, "Don't play tricks! This furniture is pressed against the marble, this is the evidence! You want to move the furniture into the house, and then refuse to admit it? Humph, I have seen too many tricks like yours. Wait until your boss comes."
"Lao Luo, Lao Luo."
The other two workers went to help Luo Hongguo, who was pushed to the ground.
"It's okay." Luo Hongguo rubbed his shoulders.
"Why are you pushing people away?"
"It's not clear whether we broke this marble, so why are you pushing people away?" The other two workers immediately glared and yelled angrily. These hard workers are not afraid of anything. If they really get angry, they may get into a fight. Even if they are arrested and taken to the police station, if these people want money but not their lives, the police station usually has nothing to do and will still let these people go.
"Don't play tricks on me!" Zhang Haobai kicked the two of them in the stomach with lightning speed.
puff! puff!
He kicked the two workers upside down and fell to the ground.
"Hmph, you don't even look at the place when you're being mean." Zhang Haobai sneered. His Zhang family had quite a lot of connections in Yi'an District, so it didn't matter if he just worked a few ordinary hard workers.
"Old Tian, ​​Big Monkey. Are you okay?" Luo Hongguo was also anxious.
"You young man, why are you doing this?" Luo Hongguo shouted angrily.
Zhang Haobai could not help but frown when he smelled the sweat on Luo Hongguo's body. He waved his hand and said, "Brother Wang, you guys teach them a lesson and tell them to be quiet."
"Master, it's from the decoration company." The bodyguard named Wang handed over his mobile phone.
"Well." Zhang Haobai waved his hand, and the three bodyguards immediately went to teach the three workers a lesson, while Zhang Haobai took the phone and said, "Yes, I'm from Tiandu Garden. I'll ask your boss, Mr. Hou, to answer the phone. Mr. Hou, what happened to your delivery person today? He was so rough that he cracked the marble pavement in my yard. Come quickly and let's take care of it! If this matter is not resolved, you won't be able to get the final payment for the furniture!"
The words have not yet been spoken——
"Stop!" A loud shout came from outside the courtyard.
At this moment, Luo Hongguo and three other workers were forced to stand in the corner of the courtyard by the three tall bodyguards, with footprints all over their bodies.
"Huh?" The three bodyguards and Zhang Haobai all turned to look.
I saw a blurry figure rushing into the courtyard instantly. Zhang Haobai recognized it at a glance and couldn't help shouting angrily: "Luo Feng, you came to my house and beat me!"
"What the hell!" Luo Feng saw his father standing in the corner with his body soaked in sweat and covered with footprints at a glance, hunched over and holding his stomach. His eyes turned red all of a sudden. His father had been sitting in such hard work for so many years and had to be looked down upon by others. Today, he still suffered from such a thing.
One of the three bodyguards, a slightly pudgy man, sneered and took a step forward.
"Fuck me!!!" Luo Feng shouted violently, and kicked him hard with a heavy, lightning-like kick. The short and fat bodyguard also used his right arm to block.
"Peng!"
The short and fat bodyguard's eyes widened immediately after the heavy kick, and he flew backwards for four to five meters before falling down. The other two bodyguards nearby were shocked.
"Luo Feng, you actually came to my house and beat my people!" Zhang Hao stared blankly and yelled, "You are looking for death."
"You are looking for death!!!" Luo Feng's eyes were filled with fierceness and he gritted his teeth and yelled angrily.
――――――
